posts.raw_content:
And we need to quit saying it as if we are. Free men don't have to get permits from the government to build a fence in their own yard. Free men don't have to get government approval to purchase or carry firearms. Free men don't eat only foods that have had their ingredients approved by the government, drive vehicle vehicles that were manufactured to meet government fuel economy and other arbitrary regulations which make them more expensive, listen to radio or watch television where the information they are consuming has to meet specific government regulations. Free men don't get threats from the government because their kid took too many days off of school to take a family vacation during the school year. Free men are not forced to stand idly by as their own country is invaded by hostile foreigners imported by our own government and funded by the money they confiscated from us. Free men do not have to pay astronomical utility bills in order to subsidize big tech. Free men don't have to wait for a specific day of the week to burn cardboard in their burn barrel. Free men do not have to keep paying the government rent just to stay on their own property after their mortgage is paid off. Free men don't have to register their vehicles with the state every year despite having the same address and still being the owner of the same vehicle. Free men are not able to be sent off to war by their own government but not trusted to have a cigarette or a drink.

We are not free men.  And we need to stop humoring the illusion that we are. We will never be free until we take a page out of our founders book and free ourselves.
